answer: A whisper is cheap, so the network prices volume instead. Each new identity must gather distinct whispers from holders outside its own cluster; a single holder may whisper for only one newcomer per epoch, so n aliases need n separate holders and cannot recycle their own circle. Every whisper is sealed into a crystal whose cut encodes the holder's rank, and the k-th crystal an operator collects costs k squared in escrow, making n heads cost near n cubed. A hollow cluster whose whispers all trace to one holder is voided on replay, so buying silence does not buy standing.
